description: A restoration has the tags of the empty production that it stands for, which are none. So helper, a unary rule over the restored optional, has no tags, and zero survives. A synthetic token gives a constituent no tag (engine §3.7, §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text A zero | A b | A c
%rule zero $x(helper)
%conditions tags($x) = ∅
%rule helper [+T]
%rule b [+T] [+T]
%rule c T
